name: Power Price Collector
short_desc: European power prices into QuestDB, MQTT, Grist and more
author: EckPhi
description: Collects European power prices and writes them to configurable sinks: QuestDB, generic InfluxDB line protocol, Telegraf, MQTT (with optional Home Assistant discovery) and Grist. Sources are a list, each owning its own bidding zones and markets — ENTSO-E for all 40 zones plus the intraday auctions and imbalance prices, Nord Pool and OMIE as independent exchanges, aWATTar and energy-charts. Ships a web UI with a form-based config editor, zone picker, component health, the price curve and a background history import. Handles 15/30/60-minute market time units and keeps negative prices intact. Configs from 1.x are migrated automatically on startup.

form_fields.label: ENTSO-E API token
form_fields.hint: Free. Register at transparency.entsoe.eu, then email transparency@entsoe.eu from that address with subject 'Restful API access'. Reference it in the config as ${ENTSOE_API_TOKEN}.

form_fields.label: QuestDB host
form_fields.hint: Host LAN IP of the QuestDB app, e.g. 192.168.1.10 — apps sit on separate compose networks, so the service name 'questdb' will not resolve. Reference it as ${QUESTDB_HOST}.

form_fields.label: MQTT host
form_fields.hint: Broker host LAN IP. Reference it as ${MQTT_HOST}.

form_fields.label: InfluxDB token
form_fields.hint: Only for the generic ILP sink pointed at InfluxDB 2.x.
